fonts.display: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'CommitMono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Page canvas, primary background — the floor everything sits on

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Card and elevated surface — one step up from canvas for contained blocks

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Borders, dividers, inset surfaces, nav background — the structural neutral

palette.name: Filament
palette.role: Hairline borders on badges, tags, and outlined controls — the machined edge

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Primary text, filled CTA background, icon strokes — the highest contrast signal

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Secondary text, subdued body copy, card labels

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Muted helper text, badge captions, metadata

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Tertiary text, icon strokes, disabled-state foreground

palette.name: Silver
palette.role: Decorative icon strokes, product-mock accent lines

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Deep icon fills, secondary button text, sparse accent

palette.name: Sleet
palette.role: Code editor chrome, light surface insets, inverted card fill

palette.name: Neon Cyan
palette.role: Blue text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Beacon Teal
palette.role: Glow halo behind hero product imagery, soft radial accent

palette.name: Amber
palette.role: Decorative icon accent, editorial highlight — the warm counterpoint to cyan
